## Points intensity based window estimation
```{r}
win_params_list <- imap(spe_list, \(spe, name) {
  
  n <- estimateReconstructionParametersSPE(
      spe,
      marks = "type",
      imageCol = "sample_id",
      markSelect = NULL,
      plotHist = TRUE, 
      nCores = 20
  )
  
  list(thres = mean(n$thres), bndw = mean(n$bndw))
})

# calculate the observation window based on the density
win_list <- map2(spe_list, win_params_list, \(spe, win_params) {
  
  allStructs <- reconstructShapeDensitySPE(
      spe,
      marks = "type",
      imageCol = "sample_id",
      markSelect = NULL,
      bndw = win_params$bndw,
      thres = win_params$thres,
      nCores = 20
  )
  combined_poly <- sf::st_union(allStructs)
  window_est <- as.owin(combined_poly)
  window_est
})

walk(win_list, plot)
```

```{r}
png("/mnt/europa/valerio/repositories/spatialPointProcess_clustering/figures/contorno_brutto.png", width = 800, height = 800, res = 150)

dev.off()
```

# Riprovo in modo diverso

Possibile soluzione

```{r}
library(imager)
library(spatstat.geom)
library(purrr)

tissue_mask_fun <- function(img_path, debris_size = 500, hole_size = 200)
{
  img <- load.image(img_path)
  gray_img <- grayscale(img)
  
  glass_mask <- threshold(gray_img, "auto")
  tissue_mask <- !glass_mask # Tissue = TRUE, Background/Holes = FALSE
  
  # =======================================================
  # STEP 2: REMOVE TISSUE DEBRIS (Delete small TRUE islands)
  # =======================================================
  tissue_components <- label(tissue_mask)
  tissue_sizes <- table(tissue_components)
  
  min_tissue_pixels <- debris_size # Debris smaller than this is deleted
  
  # Find IDs of small tissue pieces (ignore "0" which is background)
  bad_tissue_ids <- names(tissue_sizes)[tissue_sizes < min_tissue_pixels & names(tissue_sizes) != "0"]
  
  # Turn them to FALSE (background)
  tissue_mask[as.vector(tissue_components) %in% as.integer(bad_tissue_ids)] <- FALSE
  
  # plot(tissue_mask, main = "Debris Removed (Holes still intact)")
  
  # =======================================================
  # STEP 3: FILL SMALL HOLES (Delete small FALSE islands)
  # =======================================================
  # We use !tissue_mask so the algorithm counts the background/holes as the islands!
  hole_components <- label(!tissue_mask) 
  hole_sizes <- table(hole_components)
  
  # Holes smaller than this number of pixels will be filled. 
  # Large biological holes will be totally ignored and kept!
  max_hole_pixels <- hole_size 
  
  # Find IDs of small holes (ignore "0" which is now the tissue)
  small_hole_ids <- names(hole_sizes)[hole_sizes < max_hole_pixels & names(hole_sizes) != "0"]
  
  # Turn them to TRUE (tissue)
  tissue_mask[as.vector(hole_components) %in% as.integer(small_hole_ids)] <- TRUE
  
  # plot(tissue_mask, main = "Small Holes Filled (Large holes preserved!)")
  # =======================================================
  
  mask_mat <- tissue_mask[,,1,1]  
  mask_mat_y_x <- t(mask_mat)                 
  mask_spatstat <- mask_mat_y_x[nrow(mask_mat_y_x):1, ] 
  
  win_thumb <- owin(mask = mask_spatstat)
  win_thumb
}
```

```{r}
win_prova1 <- tissue_mask_fun("/mnt/ganimede/shared/imageFeatureTCGA_OV/hovernet/thumb/TCGA-25-1313-01Z-00-DX1.5A2732D5-01D6-4285-9283-1839E1703C27.png", 
                              debris_size = 500, 
                              hole_size = 200)
plot(win_prova1)

win_prova2 <- tissue_mask_fun("/mnt/ganimede/shared/imageFeatureTCGA_OV/hovernet/thumb/TCGA-23-1028-01Z-00-DX1.117B4B7B-F796-4D33-A645-CD80E5C43E6D.png",
```


```{r}
win_tentative_list <- imap(spe_list, \(spe, name) {

  base_dir <- "/mnt/ganimede/shared/imageFeatureTCGA_OV/hovernet/thumb"
  png_name <- sub("\\.svs$", ".png", name)
  img_file <- file.path(base_dir, png_name)
  
  # 4. Pass the dynamic path to your function
  win_result <- tissue_mask_fun(
    img_path = img_file, 
    debris_size = 500, 
    hole_size = 200
  )
  
  return(win_result)
})
walk(win_tentative_list, plot)
```


# Mask from HoverNet 

```{r}
win_hovernet <- imap(spe_list, \(spe, name) {

  base_dir <- "/mnt/ganimede/shared/imageFeatureTCGA_OV/hovernet/mask"
  png_name <- sub("\\.svs$", ".png", name)

})
walk(win_hovernet, plot)
```
